reviewed_behavior: Default no-op; exact WD/C deployment, helper/launcher/baseline/A80 SHA checks and original STOP pin before opt-in.
Private root environment thread equality and baseline are checked without printing identity. Reviewer did not open private handoff.
Original WorkflowLock serializes the exact HKCU RunOnce registration; value-name absence is case-insensitive, preventing replacement of an existing differently cased value.
Only the fixed NAME receives one REG_SZ with a 238-character absolute PowerShell/launcher command; FlushKey and exact value/type readback are required. No other startup value is written or deleted.

Postwrite STOP SHA is required before registered success. A write/readback failure after attempted registration retains an attempted/readback-pending state and error kind in the final receipt, instead of claiming no registration.
Original lock release is reported in the final receipt. The code contains no reboot, WSL launch, scientific command, STOP-clear or old-worker closure adoption.
fixed_draft_findings: Case-sensitive Python membership replaced by casefold matching for registry value names.
Postwrite STOP equality promoted from a recorded boolean to a success gate.
Partial write/readback failure records registration attempt and does not assert NOT_REGISTERED.
qualifications: Source-only review; no registry read/write, private-ID read, lock acquisition, boot query, CLI resume, registration or reboot by reviewer.
RunOnce is next-sign-in behavior and the no-exclamation name is removed before execution; failure is not automatically retried. The separate helper still requires a new boot and preserves old STOP.
Registry operations are not a cross-process transaction; any unexpected failure remains preserved for root reconciliation, with no automatic rollback or repeat.
The final registration receipt and original lock-released flag must be checked by root before a later restart. Actual resume and separate new-boot scope reconciliation remain NOT_RUN.

primary_sources.claim: Registry value-name lookup is not case-sensitive.
RunOnce acts on logon; command limit260; default value deletion before execution; no automatic retry without exclamation.
